title: Interest for late filing (where tax is due)
description: If you have unpaid tax and file your ITR after the due date, interest is charged at 1% per month or part of the month from the due date until the date of filing.
example: Tax due: ₹10,000. Filed 3 months late. Interest = ₹300.

title: Interest for non-payment of advance tax
description: If you did not pay advance tax and your total tax liability is ₹10,000 or more, 1% interest per month is charged from April 1st of the assessment year until you pay.
example: Tax liability: ₹50,000. No advance tax paid. Interest = 1% × months late.

title: Interest for deferment of advance tax
description: If you paid less than 15% by June 15, less than 45% by Sep 15, less than 75% by Dec 15, or less than 100% by Mar 15, interest applies on the shortfall.
example: Paid 0 by June 15. Shortfall 15%. 1% interest on 15% of total tax.

title: Late filing fee
description: If you file your ITR after the due date, a fee of ₹5,000 applies. If your total income is below ₹5 lakh, the fee is capped at ₹1,000.

title: Penalty for under-reporting / mis-reporting income
description: If the tax department finds income you didn't report, penalty can be 50% of the tax on under-reported income, or 200% for mis-reporting.
example: Hid ₹1L income. Tax on it ₹30k. Penalty up to ₹60k.
